name: BIG-Bench Hard
intro: BIG-Bench Hard（BBH）从 BIG-Bench 中筛出此前模型未超过平均人类评分者的高难任务。官方流程将 209 个评测任务逐级筛为 23 个任务（27 个子任务、6,511 个样本），为每个任务编写三个人工思维链示例，并并行比较少样本直接作答与少样本思维链提示。
build_method: BIG-Bench任务逐级筛选、人工CoT示例编写、直接作答与CoT并行评测
task_type: 多任务推理、少样本问答
eval_feature: 少样本直接作答与思维链并行、贪心解码（温度0）、固定答案短语抽取
scale: 6,511个样本，23个任务（27个子任务）；多数任务250题，例外为187、146和178题
build_method_en: Staged BIG-Bench task filtering, human CoT exemplar authoring, parallel direct-answer and CoT evaluation
eval_feature_en: Parallel few-shot answer-only and chain-of-thought, greedy decoding at temperature 0, fixed answer-phrase extraction
intro_en: BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) selects the BIG-Bench tasks on which prior models did not outperform the average human rater. The official pipeline narrows 209 evaluation tasks to 23 tasks (27 subtasks and 6,511 examples), authors three human chain-of-thought exemplars per task, and compares few-shot direct-answer prompting with few-shot chain-of-thought prompting in parallel.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2210.09261v1 Table 1 and Sections 2-3 plus the official suzgunmirac/BIG-Bench-Hard repository at commit 9ee07bd. The paper starts from 209 BIG-Bench evaluation tasks, not a pool in which every task already has model and human results. It removes tasks with more than three subtasks (209→187), fewer than 103 examples (187→130), no human-rater baseline (130→85), or a metric other than multiple choice or exact match (85→78). It then removes tasks where the best reported model beats the average human-rater (78→36) and, after manual inspection, 13 tasks that are extremely difficult or outside the paper's scope (36→23). The final 23 tasks represent 27 subtasks and 6,511 evaluation examples, usually 250 per task with 187, 146, and 178-example exceptions. Three human-written CoT exemplars are provided per task. Answer-only and CoT prompting run in parallel with greedy temperature-0 decoding; answers are extracted from the phrase 'the answer is', scored by exact match, and aggregated as an unweighted mean over 23 task accuracies.
